source_validity.axiom_i: G minus X0=G is connected: t-s4 reaches every dynamic vertex and z is reached through R.
source_validity.axiom_ii: S is connected. Every outside vertex is nonadjacent to t, hence no outside vertex is complete to S.
source_validity.axiom_iii: Exactly z is anticomplete to S outside S, so Y0={z}.
source_validity.axiom_iv: Y0 is a singleton and has no edge, so the no-mixing-on-Y0-edge condition is vacuous.
source_validity.axiom_v: Every root dynamic vertex has source-list size 3 and lies in Y.
source_validity.axiom_vi: All Y vertices adjacent to z are exactly R and share the same 3-list.

P7_free_theorem.statement: K_k is P7-free for every k.
proof: The induced subgraph on L union R union {z} is a chain graph: use bipartition (L union {z}, R), with N(l1) subset ... subset N(lk)=R=N(z). Chain graphs contain no induced P5, hence no induced P7.
Every vertex of L union R is adjacent to s4, while z and t are not.
Any induced path containing s4 can contain at most the immediate path-neighbor(s) from L union R; any further L/R vertex would create a chord to s4.
Thus no induced path containing s4 has seven vertices.
Vertex t has only neighbor s4, so any induced path using t also uses s4 and is covered by the previous case.

root_QALL.component_node: [z] adjacent to every rj because D_z=R.
root_QALL.connectedness: l_k is adjacent to every rj, so the dynamic graph is connected; [z] attaches to all R. Therefore Q_ALL is one connected block.

authorized_forcing_family.reachable_sets: Every subset F of {l1,...,l_{k-1}} is jointly reachable by repeatedly forcing li=1 in arbitrary order.
authorized_forcing_family.why_color_1_remains_available: The left side L is stable. An unforced lj is nonadjacent to every already forced li and continues to see only seed color 4 from the original seed, so 1 remains in its exact/source palette.
authorized_forcing_family.confluence: By B2B2-A the closure depends only on F, not its forcing order.

canonical_closure_for_F.seed: S_F=S union F, every li in F fixed to color 1.
canonical_closure_for_F.X0: remains empty; no source singleton arises.
canonical_closure_for_F.Y0: {z} remains residual because z is anticomplete to L.
canonical_closure_for_F.unforced_left: Every li not in F remains Y with source list {1,2,3}.
canonical_closure_for_F.right_classes: r_j becomes X with source list {2,3} iff it has a forced neighbor, equivalently iff some li in F has i>=j; otherwise r_j remains Y with source list {1,2,3}.
canonical_closure_for_F.vi: The remaining Y vertices adjacent to z are precisely the unhit r_j and all still have the same source list {1,2,3}; axiom (vi) remains valid.
canonical_closure_for_F.connectivity_repair: None is needed because X0 stays empty.
canonical_closure_for_F.QALL_connectedness: All R remain live and l_k remains live and adjacent to every R, so every canonical successor Q_ALL remains connected.

component_side_stability.message: mu_C(Fmask)=1 for every proper color mask and mu_C([4])=0; MIN_BAD(C)={[4]}.
component_side_stability.interpretation: The component-side compiled object is constant across the family. The exponential multiplicity below is not created by changing C0/C2/C3/B2A message identities.

profile_injection.canonical_marker: The unique residual component carrier [z] marks R: its dynamic neighbors are exactly R. Therefore any canonical isomorphism preserving state-coordinate types maps R to R and L to L.
profile_injection.left_signature: For every surviving li, its number of neighbors in R is exactly i.
profile_injection.recover_F: The set of surviving L-to-R degrees is exactly {i in {1,...,k}: li not in F}; since l_k is always retained, this set uniquely determines F.
profile_injection.conclusion: Distinct subsets F yield pairwise distinct canonical effect profiles even after forcing-order confluence and new-seed identity erasure.

critical_firewalls: This is NOT a strong B2B2 negative result.
Profile inequality is not yet future distinguishability.
The family may still admit a polynomial exact behavioral carrier despite exponentially many explicit profiles.
The forced assignment/reconstruction ledger itself has only O(k) explicit storage and is not an exponential representation lower bound.
